channel.title: Just the News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just the News (justthenews.com)

item.title: Cuba says four people killed, six injured after Florida speedboat opens fire in Cuban waters
item.description: When five members of the Border Guard Troops approached the Florida boat for identification, people on the boat allegedly began shooting at the Cubans and injured its commanding officer.

item.title: Deep-blue state stops forcing foster parents to affirm trans identity as Trump honors teen victim
item.description: Vermont settles two lawsuits before appeals court can strike down policy conditioning foster placements, renewals on affirming gender ideology. "We must ban" removals and transitions against parents' will "immediately," Trump says.

item.title: Midterm battle lines drawn: Patriots vs. 'Hateriots'
item.description: With midterms only about eight months away, Americans are already looking for policy adjustments from both parties to determine who gets the majority in Congress next year. Democrats appear to be flailing for any lifeline.

item.title: Iran waged decades-long revolutionary terror war against U.S. in Middle East — and here at home
item.description: Iran killed hundreds of Americans across the Middle East, with its Hezbollah proxy being the most effective terrorist group against the U.S. prior to Al-Qaeda's terror attacks on 9/11.

item.title: As Georgia prosecutor pursued Trump, Biden DOJ 'invited' her to get lucrative grant, memos show
item.description: Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis’ records, turned over to Just the News after an open records lawsuit, show her office received millions of dollars from the Biden Justice Department as she built her case against then-former President Donald Trump.

item.title: Targeted by lawsuits and demonized, Big Oil signals it’s had enough with fight against California AG
item.description: When California Attorney General Rob Bonta set out to sue ExxonMobil, alleging deception in its claims about advanced plastics recycling, he probably didn't expect the company would sue him for defamation. Bonta tried to get the case dismissed, but a federal judge in Texas has given the lawsuit the green light to proceed.

item.title: Colorado Senate passes bill making it easier to sue immigration officers
item.description: Ira Mehlman of FAIR, which advocates for limiting immigration, called the legislation “another attempt to use lawfare as a mechanism to deter or prevent ICE from carrying out its duties to enforce immigration laws.”

item.title: Mississippi is latest state to implement targeted border crime operations

item.title: Mexican citizens indicted by US for agricultural visa fraud
item.description: Mexican citizens exploiting a U.S. federal agricultural visa program have been indicted for operating forced labor operations in Florida, North Carolina and Virginia, as the Trump administration continues to crack down on visa fraud.

item.title: Either Indiana or Illinois taxpayers will be on the hook for new Bears NFL stadium
item.description: “I’m very interested to see how the people of Indiana and the voters of Indiana feel about the massive increases in taxes that are being proposed,” Illinois Gov. Pritzker said on Tuesday. He said Illinois officials continue to have positive discussions with the Bears.
